Based on my review of the entire codebase, here's what I found and what needs improvement:

## Current SEO Strengths
- **Comprehensive meta tags** on most pages (title, description, canonical, OG, Twitter)
- **Rich structured data** (SoftwareApplication, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, CollectionPage, WebApplication, HowTo, Organization, WebSite)
- **llms.txt + llms-full.txt** for GEO/AI crawlers
- **ai-plugin.json** for ChatGPT plugin discovery- **security.txt** in .well-known
- **Sitemap.xml** with 2000+ URLs, proper priorities, lastmod dates- **Robots.txt** allows AI crawlers while blocking auth pages
- **PWA manifest** with proper icons

## Issues to Fix

### 1. **Missing openapi.yaml** (Critical)
`.well-known/ai-plugin.json` references `https://appliohq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml` but this file **doesn't exist**. Either create it or remove the reference.

### 2. **salary.html missing basic SEO** (High)
- No `<meta name="description">`
- No Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
- No Twitter Card tags
- No canonical URL
- No FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, or ItemList schema### 3. **Inconsistent template counts** (Medium)
- index.html structured data: "31 templates" ✓
- resume-templates/index.html: "31 templates" ✓  - llms-full.txt: "18 templates" ✗ (outdated)
- Memory/previous docs: "26 templates" ✗### 4. **Missing WebSite SearchAction schema** (Medium)
Add to index.html for Google Sitelinks Search Box:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebSite",
  "url": "https://appliohq.com/",
  "potentialAction": {
    "@type": "SearchAction",
    "target": "https://appliohq.com/search?q={search_term_string}",
    "query-input": "required name=search_term_string"
  }
}
```

### 5. **Missing hreflang on all pages** (Low)
Only index.html has hreflang. Add to every page if keeping x-default.

### 6. **Missing robots meta on auth pages** (Low)
Add `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">` to login.html, dashboard.html, editor.html, etc. (currently only blocked via robots.txt)

### 7. **og:image using logo.jpeg instead of screenshots** (Low)
Several pages (cover-letter-generator.html, resume-examples/software-engineer.html, etc.) use `logo.jpeg` instead of page-specific screenshots. Create/verify:
- `/img/screens/cover-letter.png`
- `/img/screens/resume-examples.png`
- etc.

### 8. **Speakable schema only on some guide pages** (Low)
Add `speakable` to more high-value content pages (ATS checker, tools hub, templates).

### 9. **Missing AggregateRating on more pages** (Low)
Only index.html and salary.html have it. Add to ats-checker.html, resume-templates/, cover-letter-generator.html.

### 10. **Date freshness** (Low)
Many pages have `datePublished`/`dateModified` from 2026-07. Update to recent dates or remove if not maintaining.

---

## Quick Wins Priority Order1. **Create openapi.yaml** or fix ai-plugin.json reference2. **Add full SEO to salary.html** (description, OG, Twitter, canonical, schemas)
3. **Update llms-full.txt template count** to 314. **Add SearchAction schema to index.html**
5. **Add noindex meta to auth/dashboard pages**
6. **Audit og:image URLs** — replace logo.jpeg with real screenshots

Want me to create the openapi.yaml or fix salary.html first?
